01.speaker: A
01.text: We were waiting for the last train when the lights went out.

01.speaker: B
01.text: Did anyone tell you what had happened?

01.speaker: A
01.text: Not at first. I couldn’t look it up because I’d left my phone at home.

01.speaker: B
01.text: What did you do in the end?

01.speaker: A
01.text: We asked a member of staff and took a replacement bus. It was stressful, but we got home safely.

02.speaker: A
02.text: Have you ever organised a workshop?

02.speaker: B
02.text: Yes. I’ve helped with three so far. I organised the first one last June.

02.speaker: A
02.text: Did you speak to all the visitors yourself?

02.speaker: B
02.text: No, a colleague helped me. We’ve worked together since then.

02.speaker: A
02.text: Have you booked a venue for the next one yet?

03.speaker: A
03.text: Our flight leaves at six and the direct train has been cancelled.

03.speaker: B
03.text: We can take a coach at two, but if traffic is heavy, we may arrive late.

03.speaker: A
03.text: Could you tell me whether our tickets are valid on the three o’clock train?

03.speaker: B
03.text: They are. It’s due to reach the airport at four.

03.speaker: A
03.text: Let’s take that train, then. If it’s delayed, we’ll ask about the coach.

04.speaker: A
04.text: Room A costs eighty pounds, but it only has twenty seats.

04.speaker: B
04.text: Room B costs ninety-five and has thirty seats. It also has a lift.

04.speaker: A
04.text: Our budget is a hundred pounds. Do we need to pay extra for the projector?

04.speaker: B
04.text: No, it’s included. Room A has one too, but they charge ten pounds for it.

04.speaker: A
04.text: In that case, let’s book Room B and confirm the numbers by Thursday.

05.speaker: A
05.text: Have we finished the slides for Friday?

05.speaker: B
05.text: Yes. Sam said the room plan would be ready tomorrow, but we still need a visitor list.

05.speaker: A
05.text: I can update the list today. Could you send the access details by noon tomorrow?

05.speaker: B
05.text: Yes. I’ll send those as soon as I have the room plan.

05.speaker: A
05.text: Great. I’ll write a short note so the rest of the team knows who’s doing what.

06.speaker: A
06.text: Order D fourteen arrived damaged, so we couldn’t use it at yesterday’s event.

06.speaker: B
06.text: I’m sorry about that. Could you send me a photo and the order number?

06.speaker: A
06.text: Certainly. We’d prefer a replacement if it can arrive by Thursday.

06.speaker: B
06.text: It can be sent on Tuesday. I’ll confirm the delivery estimate by five today.

06.speaker: A
06.text: Thank you. If it won’t arrive in time, please let me know what the refund options are.

07.speaker: A
07.text: Did you hear that the library will open later in the evenings?

07.speaker: B
07.text: Only on Tuesdays and Thursdays, according to the notice.

07.speaker: B
07.text: Not yet. It’s a six-week trial. The library will ask users for feedback.

07.speaker: A
07.text: That could help people who finish work late, although some would prefer Sunday opening.

08.speaker: A
08.text: I’d like to join a course, but the evening class clashes with my shift.

08.speaker: B
08.text: Could you attend online? There’s a live class on Saturday mornings.

08.speaker: A
08.text: I can do Saturdays, but the online course is more expensive.

08.speaker: B
08.text: If I were you, I’d ask about a trial session before paying.

08.speaker: A
08.text: Good idea. If the trial is available, I’ll try it this week.

09.speaker: A
09.text: I think the centre should keep one late evening each week.

09.speaker: B
09.text: It sounds useful, but extra staffing could be expensive.

09.speaker: A
09.text: I see your point. The survey suggests Tuesday would be the most useful evening.

09.speaker: B
09.text: How many people answered the survey?

09.speaker: A
09.text: Forty. Twenty-two chose Tuesday. We could test that evening for another month.

10.speaker: A
10.text: The main hall is unavailable on Friday. The centre has offered Room B instead.

10.speaker: B
10.text: We need space for twenty-four people and step-free access. Can Room B provide both?

10.speaker: A
10.text: Yes. It seats thirty. It costs ninety-five pounds, including the projector.

10.speaker: B
10.text: In that case, let’s book it. If the lift is out of order, could we use the ground-floor room?

10.speaker: A
10.text: I’ll ask about that today and send an update to the group by noon tomorrow.
